description: T-040 statistical (John, 2026-10-16: sample counts, not wall-clock soaks): the fixed Kang Witchunter sheet (level 1, quarterstaff), set with the developer commands on a sysop's character, fights one monster sheet (`@MON@`, WCCKNMSR @MONNUM@) summoned with SYSOP MONSTER, in cycles, until this side's parallel sessions have 2,000 of the player's swings or 30 minutes have passed (`m2.stop`). stats.py compares the player's swings (hit rate, outcome mix, damage histogram, blows per round) and the monster's swings at the player (hit rate, outcome mix, damage), by their game-data texts. Played as `differential.py run --as USER:PASSWORD` by several sessions at once (m2_live.sh). Needs the developer code on both sides, as m4 (docs/testing.md).
